title: nothing-fires-on-the-heartbeat-but-its-listeners
intention: Nothing fires on the heartbeat but its two named listeners: every groundloop/pulse.py, BeatProbes and the loop's pulse calling go, and the beat calls nothing. No probe is deleted here: per open-291189a9766a's answer a probe whose WATCHME lacks a receiver gets one built, or its ticket goes to FIXME — that is 835b5736bf2b's work, not this ticket's.
why: Akien 2026-09-30: "NOTHING in the system that should fire on the heartbeat execpt the messaging"; "this is ENTIERLY an event driven system EXCEPT: Akien can say he'll be away from x to y times. and sleep."; "all probes respond to events"; "if it's not consumed, it's trash". The code still carries the shape those words reverse: 9 pulse files firing 11 probes on the beat, and 96 probes nothing fires.
traces_to: telos aim 1 (event, not poll: footprint shrinks) and Law 4, via Akien 2026-09-30: "NOTHING in the system that should fire on the heartbeat execpt the messaging", "all probes respond to events", "if it's not consumed, it's trash"; ground_loop charter falsifier (6) and filed edge (b)
how: Measured 2026-09-30: 107 probe files, 11 fired by the 9 groundloop/pulse.py files through cairn/tools/base/beat_probes.py, 96 fired by nothing since bae622881f03 removed probes/ discovery, 85 named by a ticket's WATCHME spec. Delete the 9 pulse.py files, beat_probes.py, the loop's pulse_sites/triggers.fire call, and every proof that asserts a pulse fires (the */proofs/test_groundloop_pulse.py files, including the red ones for pulse tickets never built: bin, learning_block, tester), so the beat calls nothing until the spawn ticket gives it its two listeners. Probes stay where they stand, fired by nothing until 835b5736bf2b wires each to its receiver and event (Akien, open-291189a9766a, 2026-10-01). codemother's commit watcher is the one pulse that hands live work on: it lands only after e0f318650123 gives codemother the commit through its own post-commit subscriber; counting_block's pulse already moved to post-commit under 5a4ec289bf15. On PROVED, the 11 per-device pulse tickets and 7ecdce95c42c are SUPERSEDED by this one.
falsifier: RED if after the build: (1) any groundloop/pulse.py file or cairn/tools/base/beat_probes.py exists; (2) cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/__main__.py's beat calls any module (pulse_sites/triggers.fire gone); (3) a probe module under any */probes/ directory that stood at the pre-build commit is deleted by this build (probes and their receivers are 835b5736bf2b's, per open-291189a9766a's answer); (4) a surviving probe is fired from the beat; (5) the live heartbeat stops beating with one pid (cairn-ground-loop.service active, ~/.cairn/devices/cairn/0/machines/ground_loop/liveness.json fresh); (6) a commit after the build does not reach codemother's `commit` bus verb (e0f318650123's post-commit fan-out stands before this build deletes cairn/devices/codemother/groundloop/pulse.py). WRONG INTENT if a deleted pulse carried a measurement Akien relies on that no event can carry. Horizon: the first three live beats after the build commit.
watchme: none, because the falsifier is read on every beat in the heartbeat's own record ~/.cairn/devices/cairn/0/machines/ground_loop/liveness.json: after the build its state.triggers list is empty, and a non-empty one is the red, with nothing further to learn.
builder_notes: A Haiku builder would ask: (1) Which files exactly? — the 9 paths are skills/idea, cairn/machines/counting_block, cairn/tools/ticket_inspector, cairn/tools/operator_inbox, cairn/devices/inference_domain, cairn/devices/codemother, cairn/devices/db_domain, cairn/devices/cc, cairn/devices/cairn — each <x>/groundloop/pulse.py — plus cairn/tools/base/beat_probes.py and discovery.pulse_sites + the triggers.fire call at ground_loop/__main__.py:110. (2) Which probes go? — re-run the census (grep for 'PROBE = ' under */probes*/), and for each, a consumer is 'something other than its own proof that reads its output'; WATCHME probes follow open-291189a9766a. (3) What about proofs that import the deleted modules? — each proof tooth that asserts pulse firing is deleted with its code, named in the build commit; the ground_loop proof test_heartbeat.py loses its pulse-calling teeth (its charter already says so). (4) What supersedes? — on PROVED, clear each of the 12 tickets (11 pulse + 7ecdce95c42c) to SUPERSEDED with superseded_by=<this id>, proven_by this ticket's proof, as ef06b5a49613 was on 2026-09-30.
children: none, because the event-wiring pieces for the probes that survive cannot be named until open-291189a9766a is answered; the build lists them and each is cast as its own ticket then (receiver first).

decisions.text: One of the 9 groundloop/pulse.py files is not a probe firer: cairn/machines/counting_block/groundloop/pulse.py runs the counting learning block (ticket 5a4ec289bf15, not among the 11 superseded). Its ticket is RE-POINTED to fire on commit (5a4ec289bf15 D22, 2026-09-30), not superseded. This build deletes that pulse.py and cairn/machines/counting_block/proofs/test_groundloop_pulse.py like the rest, and lands AFTER 5a4ec289bf15's post-commit host so the block is never dark; if it must land first, its commit message names the dark window and its length.
decisions.step: unlisted: a pulse file whose ticket is re-pointed, not superseded

decisions.text: Corrects D1: the counting block's re-pointing line is 5a4ec289bf15 D26, not D22 -- measured 2026-09-30 from the decide command's own output.
decisions.step: unlisted: correction to D1's line number
